title: Live web verification case 5
description: A real Workify showcase job with a public, reproducible web delivery.

criteria.requirement: The requested public delivery is clearly documented
criteria.passCondition: The source directly describes the delivered public work
criteria.failureCondition: The source contradicts or omits the delivery

criteria.requirement: The delivery includes reproducible validation information
criteria.passCondition: A reviewer can reproduce the stated validation from the public source
criteria.failureCondition: Validation is unsupported or not reproducible
